map.在线文本摘要工具，本地用自然语言处理提取文章关键句生成摘要，调节压缩比，适合长文: An online text summariser that extracts key sentences with local natural language processing to produce a summary, with adjustable compression ratio. Suitable for skimming long documents and distilling information, running purely in the front end.
map.结果区会即时更新；可一键复制结果用于记录或汇报。: The result area updates instantly; you can copy the result in one click for records or reports.
map.在浏览器本地用 NLP 抽取关键句生成摘要，支持调节压缩比，文本不上传。: Extract key sentences into a summary with local NLP in the browser, with adjustable compression ratio and no text uploaded.
map.抽取式摘要忠于原文、零上传零成本，适合长文速读；改写式需云端大模型。: Extractive summarisation stays faithful to the source with zero upload and zero cost; abstractive rewriting needs a cloud large model.
map.摘要质量依赖句子重要性打分，建议人工复核关键结论。: Summary quality depends on sentence importance scoring, so review key conclusions manually.
map.：一篇 2000 字报告，设压缩比 20% → 抽取约 400 字关键句。若关键: : for a 2000-character report at a 20% compression ratio, about 400 characters of key sentences are extracted. If the key events sit at the beginning, the summary may lean toward the early part, so check that the tail points are covered.
map.本工具在浏览器本地运行，输入内容不会上传服务器；结果为模型估算，工程决策请结合实: This tool runs locally in your browser; inputs are not uploaded; the result is a model estimate—for engineering decisions, verify against measured data.
map.抽取式和生成式摘要差在哪？: What is the difference between extractive and abstractive summaries?
map.抽取式只挑原文句子、不动写、本地零成本；生成式可重写更连贯但需联网/算力且文本外: Extractive summarisation only picks original sentences without rewriting, so it is free and local; abstractive summarisation can rewrite for better flow but needs connectivity and compute, and the text is sent out. Choose according to privacy and readability needs.
map.摘要遗漏重点怎么办？: What if the summary misses a key point?
map.调高抽取比例或换句子打分策略；关键句被埋没时常因权重算法偏向位置，可结合关键词加: Raise the extraction ratio or change the sentence scoring strategy. A key sentence getting buried often happens because the weighting algorithm favours position, so keyword weighting or manually marking key points helps.
